changes.community_button_login_indicator: Confirmed there was genuinely no login-state styling before this fix. Added a .logged-in CSS class (green glow instead of default gray) toggled on login, logout, and page load for returning logged-in players.

audit_findings.migration_completeness: Cross-checked every newState() field against load()'s migration logic. All 9 nested objects introduced across v37-v48 were already correctly deep-merged, no gaps found.
audit_findings.duplicate_functions: Scanned for any function declared more than once -- none found.
audit_findings.event_listener_leaks: Reviewed all top-level listeners -- all module-scope, executed once per page load. Dynamic panel listeners attach to freshly-rendered modal content replaced via innerHTML each render, no leak risk.
audit_findings.gold_underflow: Verified every gold-deduction path (car collision, threat penalty) clamps to never go negative.
audit_findings.prestige_correctness: Confirmed doPrestige resets exactly the intended fields while preserving upgrades, codex/achievement progress, and lifetime stats.
audit_findings.crash_risk_fixed_1: CHARS[state.character] was read in many places with no existence check -- an unrecognized character value in corrupted save data would crash the whole game. Added a fallback in load() resetting to a valid default.
audit_findings.crash_risk_fixed_2: SEEDS[f.seed] was read directly in drawCrops/openFarm with no existence check. A farm plot referencing a nonexistent seed ID would throw every frame in the render loop. Fixed: plotGrowth() now detects and safely clears such a plot, and the two remaining direct lookups use optional chaining with a fallback emoji for any caller still holding a stale reference from before the clear.

verification.community_button_tested: Confirmed via mocked login: no class before login, gains it after login, loses it after logout.
verification.crash_fix_tested: Injected a farm plot with a deliberately unrecognized seed ID and let several frames render -- confirmed zero page errors and the plot was auto-cleared instead of staying broken.
verification.existing_regression_suite_rerun: JS syntax check, road-graph integrity, stuck-at-node escape test, speed-equalization test, and standard headless-browser playthrough all pass with only expected harmless local-sandbox errors.
